//minimumReleaseAge: Longer than pnpm's own 24h floor, so Renovate never opens a PR for a version pnpm would then refuse to resolve. It is also the window in which a compromised release is usually caught.
//ignoreUnstable: This package tracks prerelease lines on purpose — effect on `rc`, Mastra on `alpha`. Renovate ignores unstable versions by default, which here would mean doing nothing at all.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.//: Peer ranges are a compatibility contract with consumers, not a version this repo runs. Widening one is a release decision and narrowing one breaks everybody already installed, so no bot touches them.

@mastra/core and @mastra/server must move together — a single bump leaves a tree where the conformance suite fails for reasons that look nothing like the cause. The test suite is versioned alongside them, so it joins the same PR.

Effect and its companion packages are released together on the rc line and must stay on the same version; @effect/platform-node at a different rc than effect is an instant type mismatch. Bumping effect also needs a `git subtree pull` that no bot can do, which CI asserts.
A dependency range this repo publishes. Raising the floor forces an upgrade on every consumer, so it is only right when the code starts using a newer API — a human call.
Tooling is low-risk and noisy; batch it.

vulnerabilityAlerts.//: A published fix for a real vulnerability outranks the quiet period.
